theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.qSDDOp_reindex
    {Outcome Outcome' : Type*}
    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype Outcome']
    (e : Outcome ≃ Outcome')
    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    (A B : OpFamily Outcome ι) :
    qSDDOp ψ A B =
      qSDDOp ψ
        ({ outcome := fun a' => A.outcome (e.symm a')
           total := A.total } : OpFamily Outcome' ι)
        ({ outcome := fun a' => B.outcome (e.symm a')
           total := B.total } : OpFamily Outcome' ι) := by sorry
